name: Metamagic Rod, Apocalyptic
body:
Price varies; Slot none; CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Lesser apocalyptic metamagic rod 3,000 gp; Apocalyptic metamagic rod 11,000 gp; Greater apocalyptic metamagic rod 24,500 gp; Aura strong (no school)

The wielder of this metamagic rod can cast up to three spells per day that blast terrain as though using the Apocalyptic Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost varies: Lesser apocalyptic metamagic rod 1,500 gp; Apocalyptic metamagic rod 5,500 gp; Greater apocalyptic metamagic rod 12,250 gp; Feats Craft Rod, Apocalyptic Spell*
